project_context.overview: Financielo is a front-end web application focused on providing a modern, clean, and functional user experience for financial control. The project features a professional aesthetic tailored for the financial sector, with an emphasis on authentication flows (login and registration) and a main landing page showcasing the application's features, pricing, and testimonials.

technology.name: HTML5
technology.description: Semantic structuring of forms and containers.

technology.name: CSS3
technology.description: Utilization of custom properties (CSS variables) and Flexbox for layout and alignment, ensuring perfect centralization and responsive design.

technology.name: JavaScript
technology.description: Logic for form validation, UI interactions (modal, navigation, theme toggling), and dynamic content updates.

technology.name: Google Fonts
technology.description: Integration of Syne (for display/titles) and DM Sans (for body text) via @import in CSS.

technology.name: Font Awesome 6.4.2
technology.description: Used for social media icons (Google, Facebook, GitHub, LinkedIn) in the authentication forms.

technology.name: Responsive Design
technology.description: Mobile-first approach with hamburger menu for navigation on smaller screens.

technology.name: CSS Animations
technology.description: Subtle animations for UI elements (e.g., blob backgrounds, hover effects).

project_context.notes: The project is currently on branch 'refactor/login-mainpage', containing a complete overhaul of the login and registration screens with focus on professional aesthetics and usability. The code is modularized with separation of concerns: HTML for structure, CSS for presentation, and JavaScript for behavior.
